{"CommandLine":"# Stop Muse service temporarily if running
Stop-Service -Name "MuseAuthService" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Stop-Process -Name "Muse*", "*muse*" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

$museSrc = "C:\Users\footb\Muse Hub"
$museDst = "E:\Muse Hub"

Write-Host "Migrating Muse Hub ($museSrc -> $museDst)..."
robocopy "$museSrc" "$museDst" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /R:2 /W:2 /MT:16 /NFL /NDL /NP

$srcCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $museSrc -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum)
$dstCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $museDst -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum)

Write-Host "Source: $($srcCount.Count) files, $($srcCount.Sum) bytes"
Write-Host "Target: $($dstCount.Count) files, $($dstCount.Sum) bytes"

if ($dstCount.Count -eq $srcCount.Count -and $dstCount.Sum -eq $srcCount.Sum -and $srcCount.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host "Muse Hub copy verified! Removing old C: directory and creating Junction..."
    Remove-Item -Path $museSrc -Recurse -Force
    cmd /c mklink /J "$museSrc" "$museDst"
    Write-Host "Muse Hub junction created successfully!"
}
